items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: You named Trepani as one back then.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Chester Jones was a good man. Uh-huh.
Fernandez was with him too. Yeah, yeah. Who were some of the good drummers in the old days? You named Trepani as one back then.
White drivers, Chani, they died. All of them, the good ones, they died out.
